tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250gu ru yon tan gter mdzod kyi las byang gi brgyud 'debs bzhugs so// 1$0000300mtha' yas rgyal ba'i ngo bo kun tu bzang*// bde chen sgyu ma'i gar mdzad rigs lnga'i lha/ khrag 'thung bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor gtso bo dgur// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// bskal bzang sgron me bzhi pa shākya thub// 'jam dbyangs spyan ras gzigs dbang gsang ba'i bdag /lha klu mi yi rig 'dzin rnam gsum bcas// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// snying po'i don rtogs grub chen dpal seṅge// paṇa grub rgya mtsho'i spyi gzugs rig 'dzin brgyad// sangs rgyas gnyis pa o rgyan rdo rje 'chang*// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// dag pa'i 'khor lnga mjing yon sad na legs// gsang sgrom sgo 'byed ye shes rol pa rtsal// mkhas grub gtsug rgyan legs ldan bdud 'joms rjer// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// grub dbang rgyal sras bstan pa'i 'byung gnas rje// rig 'dzin 'khor los sgyur ba ngag gi dbang*// 'jam mgon rdo rje 'chang dngos bka' 'gyur bar// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// snga 'gyur chos kyi nyin byed pad+ma dbang*// thams cad mkhyen pa bla med rdo rje rtsal// rdo rje 'dzin pa pad+ma phrin las zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /sdug bsngal mgon med gyur pa'i 'gro rnams la// tshad med thugs rje'i thugs kyis don mdzad pa/ dam pa khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis// smin byed dbang gis rang rgyud legs smin nas// yid bzhin nor 'dra'i man ngag bcu gsum la// tshul bzhin nyams su blangs pas 'di phyi'i don// 'bad med lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs// byin rlabs snying po mos gus bla ma'i lam// gsol 'debs gdung shugs drag pos rab 'bad pas// rang rig pad 'byung rgyal ba'i zhal mthong nas// ka dag lhun grub lam bzang mngon gyur shog

ces pa 'di dge sbyong spong ba pa rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor don grub dpal bzang gis bskul ba ltar/ thub bstan rdo rje brag gi chos smra ba dge slong pad+ma phrin las kyis bris pa'o/ kha skong pad phrin rjes su/ gnyags ston rig 'dzin pad+ma dbang gi rgyal// snying po'i don gzigs pad+ma gsang sngags rtsal// yongs rdzogs bstan 'dzin ye shes lhun grub zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// spang ston grub dbang kun bzang pad+ma'i mtshan// sgrol ston 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal// mtsho skyes gzhon nu mañju gho ṣa la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// zhes sbyar ro// zhes pa'ang blo gros mtha' yas kyi sug rjes so// //
